technical_validation.qualification: Mutable global registry was read only for ownership and was not hash-locked.

items.evidence: Paragraph 104 explains commissioner compulsion and says refusal can lead to contempt and criminal prosecution.
items.scope_review: Qualification: `can` is possibility, not automatic conviction. Called-witness/refusal conditions, commissioner limit, and paragraphs 103/107-108 safeguards are indispensable and present.

items.evidence: Paragraph 20 reports another investigation, investigator fraud findings and reference-compilation facts.
items.scope_review: Agency findings are not current-court guilt findings or a general reference-entitlement rule.

items.evidence: Paragraph 105 states that investigative means in this Commission fraud/compulsion context must respect legitimate expectations of integrity, fairness, respect and transparency.
items.scope_review: The exact `such a case` limit prevents extension to every investigation or automatic remedies.

items.evidence: Paragraph 174 merely says the preceding rhetorical question answers itself and then begins a heading.
items.scope_review: Qualification: this is useful confirmation of paragraph 173 but not a distinct standalone proposition. Unresolved safely avoids a duplicate AU and avoids falsely treating confirmation as editorial no-AU.

items.evidence: Paragraph 99 explains conditional disqualification or revocation consequences depending on appointment stage.
items.scope_review: Qualification: `could lead` and both stage conditions are essential. The next sentence's `requires investigate` paraphrase is excluded because quoted section 69 says `may investigate`; no mandatory-investigation rule is created.

items.evidence: Paragraph 44 conditionally permits objective explanation of the decision, jurisdiction and statutory powers.
items.scope_review: The as-long-as condition and paragraphs 43/45-46 context prevent conversion into unrestricted merits or fairness advocacy.

items.evidence: Paragraph 65 attributes the complete investigation-consideration list to Commission Policy.
items.scope_review: Qualification: this is policy, not statute or current-court law, and `must take into consideration whether` does not make all factors cumulative eligibility gates. Timing limits and exceptions are preserved exactly.

items.evidence: Paragraph 60 conditionally frames whether this fraud finding is defensible in facts and law.
items.scope_review: Qualification: the third-party-jurisdiction assumption and applicant-finding limit are mandatory. This is not an actual jurisdiction finding, final reasonableness result, universal standard or document-production rule; later reservations are recorded.

items.evidence: Paragraph 138 describes actual questioning, oath/compulsion and the announced two-report plan.
items.scope_review: It states neither a universal two-report duty nor a distinct general compulsion rule.

items.evidence: Paragraph 171 appraises an internal approval note and differences between the final and revised factual reports.
items.scope_review: It is record history, not a general finality or draft-comment rule.
